outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (breast anatomy diagram) plus a classification table; no bar chart or averaged data plot is present.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating circadian phenotypes and study relationships; no data plot is shown.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental setup for luciferase recordings; no quantitative plot is present.
Panel D shows illustrative line traces of circadian signals (model examples) embedded in a schematic workflow; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E shows an illustrative correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F contains a schematic plus an illustrative line plot of cell number over time for example models; line plots are exempt.
Panel G contains a schematic plus an illustrative dose-response line plot; line plots are exempt from the requirement.
Panel H shows illustrative gene-expression and mutation heatmaps; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel I contains PCA and 3D scatter plots showing individual cluster points directly; scatter plots are exempt (points themselves are the data).
